cohort: 312 primigravid pregnant women who received antenatal care at three tertiary referral hospitals in northern Ghana between February 2019 and June 2020
finding: While several factors were associated with LBW, only increased gestational age at delivery remained a significant predictor for reduced odds of LBW after adjusting for confounders.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be associated with increased odds of LBW.
